name: Twisted Hatred

angles.text: As a night elf, you know Teldrassil as the new heart of Kaldorei resurgence. Demonic corruption among its native wildlife in the Cleft threatens your people.
As a druid, you know that befouling Teldrassil’s natural spiders strikes at nature’s balance. Cenarion defenders must cleanse the brood.
As an Alliance member, you help Tallonkai Swiftroot protect Dolanaar from satyr schemes within Teldrassil, the Alliance’s primary sanctuary on Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Xethorr the Wicked is a satyr who orchestrated corruption within Teldrassil. He directed Lord Melenas and made his lair in the Cleft, where he twisted native spiders and used Mature Fel Moss in his schemes.
The Cleft lies deep in Teldrassil’s forest, northwest of Dolanaar. Xethorr the Wicked and his befouled brood have taken residence there.
Xethorr the Wicked corrupted the Befouled Webwoods, native spiders of Teldrassil. He twisted their minds and bodies to harvest their venom for a demonic plan.
faq.q: Why are the spiders of Teldrassil befouled?

faq.answer: Tallonkai Swiftroot is a night elf guardian stationed in Dolanaar on Teldrassil. He sends adventurers to root out demonic subversion in the surrounding woods.
Mature Fel Moss is a corrupting botanical specimen carried by Xethorr the Wicked. Tallonkai Swiftroot seeks it to learn more about the satyr’s motives and work within Teldrassil.
faq.q: What is the Mature Fel Moss?

faq.answer: Lord Melenas acted at Xethorr the Wicked’s behest, not from isolated malice. His deeds revealed a coordinated satyr conspiracy within Teldrassil.

sections.body: Lord Melenas had a master in Xethorr the Wicked. The satyr held an entrenched presence in Teldrassil’s wilderness, pulling strings from the forest shadows to trouble the World Tree’s quiet boughs.
sections.title: A Shadowed Handler

sections.body: Northwest of Dolanaar, Xethorr turned Teldrassil’s native Webwood spiders into befouled beasts. From the secluded Cleft, the satyr meant to wield their venom in demonic plots. Tallonkai Swiftroot sent adventurers to cull the brood and seize Xethorr’s Mature Fel Moss before the corruption spread.
sections.title: The Befouled Brood of the Cleft

summary: In Teldrassil, Xethorr the Wicked’s schemes draw you to the Cleft northwest of Dolanaar. There you face the satyr and cull his corrupted spiders before their venom serves his demonic plots.
